rounds.text: The company’s long-term growth narrative is rapidly deteriorating, as evidenced by the collapse in compounded sales growth from 73% over ten years to a contraction of 19% over the trailing twelve months [E14, E17]. This deceleration is further confirmed by the company’s poor five-year sales growth of 5.83% and the explicit flagging of decelerating earnings growth [E61, E69]. While the stock trades at a discount to book value, this valuation is likely a reflection of poor asset efficiency, evidenced by a return on assets of -9.43% compared to the sector benchmark of 1.55% [E2, E8]. Investors are also denied any immediate return on capital, as the dividend yield is 0.00% [E4]. Conceded: [E1, E2, E7, E14, E55, E65, E66]. The stock’s position at only 29% of its 52-week range suggests that market sentiment remains cautious regarding these fundamental headwinds [E5].
